page_title: INT 4-0 ATA | Inter v Atalanta 30/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Matteo Marchetti has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+3' Atalanta quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
90' A quickly taken corner by Inter.

90' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) produces a brilliant low pass into the box, where Mehdi Taremi is already waiting. He attempts to dribble past the defence, but one of the defenders does well to dispossess him. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
88' Ederson (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
88' Matteo Darmian (Inter) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Marco Palestra (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.
85' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
84' Marco Palestra (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
83' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Lautaro Martinez.
82' A goal, which was scored by Federico Dimarco (Inter), was disallowed due to offside.
80' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Davide Zappacosta leaves the pitch and Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) comes on.
80' That will be all from Lazar Samardzic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marco Palestra (Atalanta).
79' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Marcus Thuram will be replaced by Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
79' Substitution. Nicolo Barella makes way for Davide Frattesi (Inter).
78' 11:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
77' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
75' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
75' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
74' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
73' Ederson (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call.
71' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
70' None of the Atalanta players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
67' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
67' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
61' It is time for a substitution. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is on for Hakan Calhanoglu.
61' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Augusto (Inter) replacing Alessandro Bastoni.
61' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) commits a foul during an attacking move.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Raoul Bellanova.
56' 4 - 0 Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 4:0.
56' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

55' Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Inter.
55' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Nicolo Barella (Inter) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
54' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes it short.
54' A cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
53' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
50' Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mateo Retegui (Atalanta).
47' 3 - 0 Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 3:0.
46' That was close by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
46' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
43' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
42' Federico Dimarco (Inter) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
39' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
38' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Mateo Retegui (Atalanta).
38' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Yann Sommer punches the ball away.
36' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
35' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' The ball is cleared after Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
31' A lofted cross from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.
27' Marcus Thuram (Inter) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the left post!
25' A cooling break is underway.
25' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
24' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
21' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
18' The foul by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) was seen by Matteo Marchetti who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
15' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

15' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
14' Nicolo Barella (Inter) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
13' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.

10' 2 - 0 Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the right post. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:0.
8' What a strike! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) hits the left post from the free kick.
7' Ederson (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul. Inter have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
3' 1 - 0 This is definitely not what Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:0.
2' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
